findings.title: Barrier extractor accepts an unrecorded gate token as publication authorization
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:34 and results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:30-34 require an explicit check_action ALLOW before Q2 barrier extraction/publication.
scripts/27_extract_barriers.py:91-95 validates only a token's format and five blacklist literals; it never resolves a consultation record or verifies ALLOW, commit, or action binding.

In an isolated clone of the fixed commit, a valid-format unrecorded token arbitrary exited 0 and wrote a nonempty extraction JSON; the record contained both production-leg iteration counts and custody metadata.
scripts/20_test_checks.py:1365-1380 tests only PENDING, NONE, DENY, and PLACEHOLDER, so its green group 47 does not exercise the arbitrary-token bypass.
reproduce: d=$(mktemp -d) && python3 scripts/27_extract_barriers.py --gate-token arbitrary --out "$d/unauthorized.json" && test -s "$d/unauthorized.json"

proposed_check: C-GATE-003 — require the extractor to dereference an authenticated ALLOW record bound to the audited commit and publish_claim; run fixtures for a valid authenticated token and a syntactically valid unrecorded token, requiring only the former to create an output record.

summary: BLOCK: the new Q2 barrier extractor can materialize a result with an arbitrary valid-format token instead of a verified check_action ALLOW. No previous finding is currently open or requested for re-audit in cycle_context.json.

coverage.method: Read the canonical index and Q2 authorities first, then traced the new commit's extractor, its regression, paired inputs, custody records, and compressed raw outputs; executed the suite and an unauthorized-token probe only in an isolated clone.
not_examined: Full line-by-line scientific recomputation of the unrelated Objective 2 MACE corpus and XRD sub-project
Remote controller consultation service or HPC state, which was not available and was not contacted
